# this file replaces '1_inc_analysis' by including the 'sneek' variable in place of 'sniff' where applicable

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)

library(tidyverse)
library(readxl)
library(lme4)
library(lmerTest)
library(reghelper)
library(interactions)
```

## import data

```{r import data}
inc_raw_data = read_excel("data/inc_all_data_final.xlsx",sheet = "raw_data")
inc_dbl_scr_hand = read_excel("data/inc_all_data_final.xlsx",sheet = "double_scored")
```

```{r double score data}
# double score the data by averaging across the coders for each rat, session, drug, sex, and timepoint

inc_raw_data %>%
  group_by(subject,drug,sex,session,time) %>%
  summarise(beam = mean(beam_breaks,na.rm = TRUE),
            sniff_cnt = mean(sniff_cnt,na.rm = TRUE),
            sniff = mean(sniffing,na.rm = TRUE),
            groom_cnt = mean(groom_cnt,na.rm = TRUE),
            groom = mean(grooming,na.rm = TRUE),
            shake = mean(shakes,na.rm = TRUE),
            seek_cnt = mean(seeking_cnt,na.rm = TRUE),
            seek = mean(seeking,na.rm = TRUE),
            lever = mean(lever,na.rm = TRUE)) -> inc_dbl_scr

# inc_dbl_scr$time = as.factor(inc_dbl_scr$time)
inc_dbl_scr$session = as.factor(inc_dbl_scr$session)

inc_dbl_scr$sex = as.factor(inc_dbl_scr$sex)
inc_dbl_scr$drug = as.factor(inc_dbl_scr$drug)

# create inc_sneek
inc_dbl_scr %>%
  mutate(seek = ifelse(is.nan(seek), 0, seek),
         sneek = seek + sniff,
         sneek_cnt = seek_cnt + sniff_cnt) -> inc_sneek
```



## How do drug and session relate to lever pressing?

```{r}
lev_m1 <- lmer(lever ~ session + (1|subject),data = inc_sneek)

lev_m2 <- lmer(lever ~ session + drug + (1|subject),data = inc_sneek)
anova(lev_m1,lev_m2)

# model 2 wins
```

```{r}
lev_m3 <- lmer(lever ~ session + drug + time + (1|subject),data = inc_sneek)
anova(lev_m3,lev_m2)

# model 3 wins

lev_m4 <- lmer(lever ~ session * drug + time + (1|subject),data = inc_sneek)
anova(lev_m4,lev_m3)

# model 4 wins
```

```{r}
lev_m5 <- lmer(lever ~ session + drug + time + session:drug + drug:time + (1|subject),data = inc_sneek)
anova(lev_m5,lev_m4)

# model 5 winner

lev_m6 <- lmer(lever ~ session + drug + time + session:drug + drug:time + session:time + (1|subject),data = inc_sneek)
anova(lev_m6,lev_m5)

# model 5 and 6 not different

lev_m7 <- lmer(lever ~ session * drug * time + (1|subject),data = inc_sneek)
summary(lev_m7)
anova(lev_m7)
anova(lev_m5_rev,lev_m7)
```

```{r}
# revision: reviewer 1 comment 4
lev_m5 <- lmer(lever ~ session + drug + time + session:drug + drug:time + (1|subject),data = inc_sneek)


lev_m5_rev <- lmer(lever ~ session*drug + drug*time + (1|subject),data = inc_sneek)
summary(lev_m5)
anova(lev_m5)
summary(lev_m5_rev)
anova(lev_m5_rev)
```



```{r}
summary(lev_m7)
simple_slopes(lev_m7)
interact_plot(model = lev_m7, pred = "time", modx = "session")
```

```{r winning model summary}
summary(lev_m5)
simple_slopes(lev_m5, levels=list(drug=c(1,2,'sstest'),time=c(1,2,3,4,5,6,'sstest')))
```

```{r}
sim_slopes(model = lev_m5, pred = "session", modx = "drug")
interact_plot(model = lev_m5, pred = "session", modx = "drug", interval = TRUE)

# lever pressing incubating more for heroin than sucrose (sucrose higher overall)
```

```{r fig 1a}
library(emmeans)
library(pbkrtest)
library(tidyverse)
library(lmerTest)

lev_fig1_df <- inc_sneek %>%
  mutate(reward = case_when(drug == 1 ~ "Heroin",
                            drug == 2 ~ "Sucrose"))

lev_fig1 <- lmer(lever ~ session*reward + reward*time + (1|subject),data = lev_fig1_df)
summary(lev_fig1)

emms <- emmeans(lev_fig1, ~ session * reward)
emms_df <- as.data.frame(emms)

# Modify the levels of drug to label them as "Heroin" and "Sucrose"
# emms_df$drug <- factor(emms_df$drug, levels = c(1, 2), labels = c("Heroin", "Sucrose"))

# Create the plot with customizations
ggplot(emms_df, aes(x = session, y = emmean, color = reward, group = reward)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 10) +  # Change line thickness here
  geom_point(size = 15) +   # Change point size here
  labs(x = "Session", y = "Lever Presses", 
       color = "Drug", 
       title = "") + # Interaction of Session and Drug on Lever Pressing
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(size = 50), 
        axis.title = element_text(size = 50)) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("Heroin" = rgb(1, 0.4, 0, 0.5), "Sucrose" = rgb(0, 0.8, 1, 0.5))) +
  # theme(plot.margin = margin(10, 10, 10, 10)) +
  theme(legend.title = element_text(size = 40), 
        legend.text = element_text(size = 40),
        axis.text.x = element_text(size = 40),   # Adjust x-axis label text size here
        axis.text.y = element_text(size = 40)) + # Adjust y-axis label text size here
  scale_y_continuous(breaks = 1:7, limits = c(1, 7))

# Resize the plot
ggsave("session_drug_interaction_plot.png", width = 16, height = 12)  # Save with specific dimensions

ggsave("figures/fig1a.eps", width = 16, height = 12)  # Save with specific dimensions
```


```{r}
sim_slopes(model = lev_m5, pred = "time", modx = "drug")
interact_plot(model = lev_m5, pred = "time", modx = "drug", interval = TRUE)

# lever pressing decreasing faster for sucrose
```

```{r fig 1b}
library(emmeans)
library(ggplot2)

summary(lev_fig1)

# Create a sequence of 'time' values to predict for (adjust the range as needed)
time_values <- seq(min(lev_fig1_df$time), max(lev_fig1_df$time), length.out = 100)

# Get estimated marginal means for the interaction between time and drug
emms_time_drug <- emmeans(lev_fig1, ~ time * reward, at = list(time = time_values))

# Convert to a data frame for plotting
emms_time_drug_df <- as.data.frame(emms_time_drug)

# Modify the drug factor to label them as "Heroin" and "Sucrose"
emms_time_drug_df$reward <- factor(emms_time_drug_df$reward) # , levels = c(1, 2), labels = c("Heroin", "Sucrose")

# Plot using ggplot2, adding confidence intervals and showing all x-axis labels
ggplot(emms_time_drug_df, aes(x = time, y = emmean, color = reward, group = reward)) +
  # Add confidence intervals using geom_ribbon (shaded area)
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = lower.CL, ymax = upper.CL, fill = reward), alpha = 0.5, color = NA) +
  geom_line(size = 5) +  # Line thickness
  labs(x = "Time", y = "Lever Presses", 
       color = "Drug", fill = "Drug", 
       title = "") + # Interaction of Time and Drug on Lever Pressing
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(size = 50), 
        axis.title = element_text(size = 50)) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("Heroin" = rgb(1, 0.4, 0, 0.5), "Sucrose" = rgb(0, 0.8, 1, 0.5))) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Heroin" = rgb(1, 0.4, 0, 0.5), "Sucrose" = rgb(0, 0.8, 1, 0.5))) +  # Match line color for confidence interval
  # theme(plot.margin = margin(10, 10, 10, 10)) +
  theme(legend.title = element_text(size = 40), 
        legend.text = element_text(size = 40),
        axis.text.x = element_text(size = 40),   # Adjust x-axis label text size here
        axis.text.y = element_text(size = 40)) + # Adjust y-axis label text size here
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = 1:6) + # Ensure all x-axis labels are shown
  scale_y_continuous(breaks = 1:7)

# Resize the plot (optional)
#ggsave("time_drug_interaction_with_CI_plot.png", width = 16, height = 12)

ggsave("figures/fig1b.eps", width = 16, height = 12)
```



### correlation map



# correlational heat map across four conditions

```{r fig 3 correlations}
library(tidyverse)
library(corrplot)

# Define custom labels
var_labels <- c("Lever Presses", "Locomotion", "Sniffing", "Grooming", "Shakes")


# Step 1: Get all combinations of drug and session
combinations <- expand.grid(
  reward = c("Heroin", "Sucrose"),
  day = c("Day 1", "Day 30"),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

# step 1a: mutate inc_sneek
inc_sneek <- inc_sneek %>%
  mutate(reward = case_when(drug == 1 ~ "Heroin",
                            drug == 2 ~ "Sucrose"),
         day = case_when(session == 1 ~ "Day 1",
                          session == 2 ~ "Day 30"))

# Step 2: Set up plotting area
postscript(
  "figures/fig3.eps",
  width = 7,
  height = 7,
  horizontal = FALSE,
  onefile = FALSE,
  paper = "special"
)

par(mfrow = c(2, 2), mar = c(2, 2, 4, 2))

# Step 3: Loop through each combination
for (i in 1:nrow(combinations)) {
  d <- combinations$reward[i]
  s <- combinations$day[i]
  
  # Filter and compute subject-level means
  df_sub <- inc_sneek %>%
    filter(reward == d, day == s) %>%
    group_by(subject) %>%
    summarise(across(c(lever, beam, sneek, groom, shake), mean, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")
  
  # Compute correlation matrix
  cor_matrix <- cor(df_sub[, -1], use = "pairwise.complete.obs")
  
  # Set axis labels
  colnames(cor_matrix) <- var_labels
  rownames(cor_matrix) <- var_labels
  
  # Plot
  corrplot(
    cor_matrix,
    method = "color",
    type = "lower",
    addCoef.col = "black",
    tl.col = "black",
    tl.cex = 0.7,
    t.srt = 45,
    number.cex = 0.9,
    diag = FALSE,
    title = paste0(d, " - ", s),
    mar = c(0, 0, 2, 0)  # margin for title
  )
}

# Step 4: Close PNG device
dev.off()

```
